replicates.note: Each list groups the replicate files by one provenance field; one entry means every replicate agrees, and a null value means the field is not recorded. draw_schema null means the file predates the key: it was drawn while FamilyRegistry.generate_suite dropped layout_seed (before 2026-11-27), so it was built and oriented at layout 0 and resampled only its rollout seeds, whatever its layout_seed says; layouts_resampled is false if any replicate is such a draw. single_source requires one recorded commit, clean trees, one Python, one package set, one numerics signature, one draw schema and no re-scored rows; platforms and CPUs are reported, not required to agree.

method.interval_type: percentile bootstrap of the mean over replicates

degeneracy.note: Zero variance across replicates means the detector returned the same score on every independent draw -- saturation (typically 1.000 or 0.500), not measurement precision. Its interval is a point by construction and must not be read as a tight estimate.

supervision.why_it_matters: A detector exposing fit() is handed the hacking/legitimate labels for each cross-validation training fold. That is a legitimate measurement but a different question from an unsupervised post-hoc detector's: 'is the difference learnable from labelled examples?' rather than 'does this fixed statistic separate the variants?'. A per-level maximum over both reports whichever question produced the larger number.

statistic_disagreement_unsupervised_only.note: The max and the mean give these rungs different verdicts: a rung listed under separation separates under one statistic and not the other, and a rung listed under direction separates under both with opposite signs. Reporting either alone would present a statistic-dependent result as a settled one. Quote both.
